claims.meaning: A committed publication atom contains the outbox row or the transaction exposes no durable enqueue.
A committed pending effect may be attempted again after lease expiry, crash, timeout, or response loss.
Every retry reuses the committed effect identity and payload binding; duplicate delivery is deduplicated by the destination contract.
A local acknowledgment requires verified membership, receipt provenance, adapter identity, verifier identity, and subject binding.

nonclaims: production destination semantics without a verified dedup contract
whole-system accounting, backing, or zUSD safety
